dialogues.speaker: Matzahtli
dialogues.text: So, the biological fire rain is actually those Flowfire Birds falling from the sky? Ah, no wonder they cover way more ground than a normal eruption!

dialogues.speaker: Matzahtli
dialogues.text: Oh no, what if one of them crashes into my house someday? No, I gotta figure out a plan for this.

choices.text: Well, it's probably just a rare thing.

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: Yeah, yeah, those Flowfire Birds only get up there because of volcanic eruptions. My house isn't anywhere near a volcano, so I'm probably fine.

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: But... what if — just what if — there's some crazy, massive eruption one day? Wouldn't that mean nowhere is safe? Ugh, no, I still need to come up with a plan... just in case.

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: No worries, you're not interrupting... Anyway, let's start by reinforcing the roof.
